concerns.text: Task T007 specifies 'a sufficient number of iterations... to ensure statistical convergence' instead of the fixed '1,000' mandated by FR-004. This semantic weakening removes the deterministic completion criterion and violates the spec's explicit iteration count.

Task T004 logs a warning for dataset count deviation but omits the mandatory state-manifest update required by Constitution Principle V (Versioning Discipline). The task must explicitly instruct updating `state/...yaml` artifact_hashes and `updated_at` upon deviation.

Task T022 isolates 'zero-variance sample detection' as a separate task, whereas FR-002 and the Edge Cases section require this logic to be internal to the augmentation/subsampling flow. This fragmentation risks incomplete implementation of the single requirement.

Tasks T034/T035 defer runtime/memory validation to 'Polish'. SC-004/SC-005 define these as mandatory feasibility gates. Deferring them risks the core simulation exceeding the 6-hour/7GB limits only after implementation, violating the success criteria.

Task T013 conflates the 'Baseline' (US1) with 'Ground Truth' conditions (permutation/shift) defined in the Plan. US1 requires testing 'original, non-augmented' data; the permutation/shift logic belongs to the experimental conditions (Null/Alt) in US2/US3, not the baseline definition.
